title: Spend $499 on iPad: Done. What else do iGet?
summary: This article discusses the hidden costs associated with owning Apple's iPad beyond its initial $499 purchase price. It highlights additional expenses such as protective covers, keyboard docks, apps, and extended warranties, often pushing the total cost significantly higher than advertised. The piece uses examples of iPad owners to illustrate how these extra purchases quickly add up.

title: Blockbuster CEO’s Netflix Knocks Bounce Back
summary: Blockbuster CEO Jim Keyes defended the company's brick-and-mortar model against Netflix's subscription service, arguing that Blockbuster's store-based approach and new release advantage better meet customer demand. The article critiques Keyes's argument, highlighting Blockbuster's declining revenue and Netflix's superior customer satisfaction, suggesting that Blockbuster's model primarily benefits studios, not customers.

title: U.S. top court to hear Costco-Swatch copyright case
summary: The U.S. Supreme Court will hear an appeal from Costco Wholesale Corp. in a copyright infringement dispute with a Swatch Group unit, Omega, regarding imported Swiss-made watches. The case centers on the applicability of the U.S. Copyright Act's first-sale doctrine to goods manufactured abroad and imported through the "grey market." This dispute has significant implications for brand owners' control over distribution and retailers' ability to sell imported goods.
